content.text:
**Finding submitted — deviation (GOVLAW).**

- **Governing law:** § 10.5 selects New York law, which is our preferred position and needs no change.
- **Venue:** searches for jurisdiction, venue, courts, arbitration, dispute resolution and injunctive relief returned no other responsive provision — the Agreement fixes no forum at all. There is no arbitration clause, so this is not walk-away territory, but the absence of an exclusive forum leaves HDI free to litigate in New Jersey and fails the venue element at both preferred and fallback levels.
- **Cure:** one inserted sentence after § 10.5 giving the state and federal courts in New York County exclusive jurisdiction over the merits, with only temporary injunctive relief available elsewhere. The existing governing-law sentence is preserved verbatim.
